function()
					local wapi = game_react_globals.getDefaultWindowApi()
					if wapi == nil then
						return
					end
					wapi.addSingletonWindow(recipes.TfuiExampleAbout, {})
					pcall(function()
						api.gui.byId.setVisible("tfui_example_en.new_window", true)
					end)
					wapi.moveSingletonWindowToFront(recipes.TfuiExampleAbout)
				end
